name: The Unknowns Saga Vol 2: Monsters Rising
source: Ancient Monsters have started to reclaim their freedom from a life long prison. The only obstacle standing in there way is the Unknowns. Its up to the Unknowns to stop the Ancient monsters and free people from their control.
